statement: If, as a whole is to a whole, so is a part subtracted to a part subtracted, the remainder will also be to the remainder as whole to whole.
heath_proof: For, as the whole AB is to the whole CD, so let the part AE subtracted be to the part CF subtracted; I say that the remainder EB will also be to the remainder FD as the whole AB to the whole CD. For since, as AB is to CD, so is AE to CF, alternately also, as BA is to AE, so is DC to CF. [V. 16] And, since the magnitudes are proportional componendo, they will also be proportional separando, [V. 17] that is, as BE is to EA, so is DF to CF, and, alternately, as BE is to DF, so is EA to FC. [V. 16] But, as AE is to CF, so by hypothesis is the whole AB to the whole CD. Therefore also the remainder EB will be to the remainder FD as the whole AB is to the whole CD. [V. 11]
ai_proof_text:
5.19
**Statement:** If, as a whole is to a whole, so is a part subtracted to a part subtracted, the remainder will also be to the remainder as whole to whole.

**Step 1.** Let AB and CD be two wholes, let AE be a part subtracted from AB and CF a part subtracted from CD, so that EB is the remainder of AB and FD the remainder of CD; and let the whole AB be to the whole CD as the subtracted part AE is to the subtracted part CF, that is, AB : CD = AE : CF. It is required to prove that the remainder EB is to the remainder FD as the whole AB is to the whole CD.

**Step 2.** Since the four magnitudes AB, CD, AE, CF are proportional, AB : CD = AE : CF, they are also proportional alternately [5.16]; therefore AB : AE = CD : CF.

**Step 3.** Now AB is made up of the two magnitudes EB and AE, and CD is made up of FD and CF. Hence the proportion AB : AE = CD : CF says that EB together with AE is to AE as FD together with CF is to CF; that is, the magnitudes EB, AE, FD, CF are proportional componendo. Therefore they are also proportional separando [5.17]: the excess EB, by which AB exceeds AE, is to AE as the excess FD, by which CD exceeds CF, is to CF; that is, EB : AE = FD : CF.

**Step 4.** Since EB : AE = FD : CF, these four magnitudes are also proportional alternately [5.16]; therefore EB : FD = AE : CF. (The remainders EB and FD are of the same kind, being parts of the wholes AB and CD, which have a ratio to one another; so the ratio EB : FD exists.)

**Step 5.** But by hypothesis AE : CF = AB : CD. Thus the ratio EB : FD and the ratio AB : CD are each the same as the ratio AE : CF. Ratios which are the same with the same ratio are also the same with one another [5.11]; therefore EB : FD = AB : CD.

**Step 6.** Therefore the remainder EB is to the remainder FD as the whole AB is to the whole CD. Q.E.D.
